text: Refunds can be requested within 30 days of purchase. Items must be unused and in original packaging. Refunds are issued to the original payment method within 5 business days of approval.
Gift cards, digital downloads and personalised items cannot be refunded. Clearance items are final sale and are not eligible for return or exchange.
Standard shipping takes three to five business days within the continental United States. Orders placed after 2pm Pacific ship the following business day.
Expedited shipping arrives in one to two business days for an additional fourteen dollars. Overnight delivery is available to most metro areas if ordered before noon Pacific.
International orders ship to 42 countries and typically arrive in 7 to 14 business days. Customs duties and import taxes are the responsibility of the recipient.
The delivery address on an order can be changed until the order enters the packing stage, usually within two hours of placing it. After that the package must be intercepted with the carrier.
Orders can be cancelled for a full refund any time before they ship. Once a tracking number is issued the order cannot be cancelled and must be returned instead.
A tracking number is emailed when your order ships. Tracking can take up to 24 hours to show movement after the label is created.
To reset your password, select Forgot Password on the sign-in screen. The reset link is valid for one hour. If it expires, request a new one.
To close your account permanently, contact support. Closure removes saved payment methods and order history and cannot be reversed.
Hardware carries a two year limited warranty covering manufacturing defects. Accidental damage, water damage and normal cosmetic wear are not covered.
To make a warranty claim you need your order number and a photograph of the defect. Approved claims are replaced rather than repaired.
We accept Visa, Mastercard, American Express, Apple Pay and Google Pay. We do not accept cheques, wire transfers or cryptocurrency.
A declined card is usually a billing address mismatch or an issuer hold. Confirm the address matches your statement exactly, then retry or use a different card.
